title: eJay 2: Dance, HipHop and Techno eJay

note.windows: Point it at your eJay 2 disc, its .iso, or the installed program. The build takes a few minutes and about 2 GB; it needs Visual Studio's C++ build tools (about 3 GB), which are installed if they are missing - Windows asks for permission once.
note.darwin: Point it at your eJay 2 disc, its .iso, or the installed program. The build takes a few minutes and about 2 GB. It needs Homebrew and Xcode's command line tools, and installs the rest with Homebrew.
note.default: Point it at your eJay 2 disc, its .iso, or the installed program. The build takes a few minutes and about 2 GB. It needs gcc, CMake, Ninja, SDL2, SDL2_ttf, the Liberation fonts and Python's pefile and capstone from your package manager; if any are missing it says which, with the command to install them.
